title: The Hospitals Contribution Fund of Australia Limited (HCF) - proposed acquisition of Manchester Unity Australia Limited
acquirers: The Hospitals Contribution Fund of Australia Limited (HCF)

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant markets to be: - state-based markets for the supply of private health insurance (PHI) to consumers; and - local, regional or state/territory based markets for the acquisition of services from private hospitals by PHI providers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition unlikely to give rise to a substantial lessening of competition in any relevant market given: - the relatively small change in market structure arising from the proposed acquisition; and - the existence of alternative significant suppliers.
